name: Zero-dollar / null-missing pricing line safe handling
what_it_tests: A $0 line (included component / bundled feature) and a line with no active PricebookEntry (legacy/retired SKU) must not fail the pricing engine or approval logic and must not throw a null-reference
proc_mechanism: CalculationMatrix / pricing formula $0-safe; approval matrix does not block $0; missing-PBE falls back to $0 or graceful warning per design
expected_behavior: $0 line displays 0.00 with no validation error, included in order/invoice; missing-PBE warns 'No pricing found' or defaults $0, no exception
test_setup: Bundled $0 item (e.g. NSS SNMP Trap Receiver in Powertech renewal); and a Legacy_Product='Yes' SKU with no current PBE

prior_run.actual: $0 line Metrics Catalog PS-AM: UnitPrice/NetUnitPrice/TotalPrice/NetTotalPrice all 0.00, remained on quote, no VR error. Inactive-PBE legacy SKU (DCS Advanced Bundle OLD, IsActive=false) silently dropped at DML (Id=null, no exception). REST place Force reprice isSuccess=true errorResponse=[]. Anchor NSS SNMP Trap Receiver NetUnitPrice=2800; header TotalPrice/Subtotal/GrandTotal/ALE__c=2800 (uncorrupted).
prior_run.notes: V21 step 4 'All Lines Null Safe Filter' + steps 85-86 Null-Check/Null-Safe Line Adjustment keep the $0 line safe. Missing-PBE handled at DML layer (inactive PBE line not persisted, no engine NPE). defect_provenance SC-3345/SC-3347 not reproduced. Script setupK06ZeroAndMissingPbeTestData.compact.apex.
